Application In Support Of Order Dispensing With Notice To Minor'S Parent
Off Calendar Oct-25-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: K. Farnsworth.
Petitioner: Norma Rodriguez, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Saul Antonio Segura, was sworn and examined.
Petitioner's Application In Support Of and for an Order Dispensing With Notice To Minor's father: Oswaldo Antonio Segura, is Granted in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Saul Antonio Rodriguez.
Decree signed in open court.

MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Roseleen O'Brien.
Petitioner: Norma Rodriguez, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Saul Antonio Segura, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to Oct. 25, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to submit proof of service to the Minor's father of the new hearing date or file the Declaration and Application for an Order dispensing with notice.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
